title: Validate fixed-tick physical device captures
requires: Host able to run the portable Python conformance tests
scope: Implement the backend-neutral validator for physical fixed-tick qualification captures. It consumes public observation artifacts and the frozen realtime-single-step-v1 oracle contract, rejects incomplete or relabeled evidence, and reports exact candidate/device identity. It does not produce device captures or change physics, scenario fixtures, fixed work budgets, advertised capabilities, tolerances, candidate manifests, or legacy variable-timestep profiles.
acceptance: The validator requires exact candidate manifest, runtime target, binary, device and toolchain identity; every one of the 49 frozen capability rows must pass execution, analytic and lifecycle checks, and all 30 public cases must complete without driver-private state.

The validator requires each target workload's exact sample count, 600 warm-up ticks, 7200 measured ticks, at least 0.99 simulated/wall-time ratio, and finite monotonic CPU, GPU, physics and frame p50/p95/p99/max distributions within the frozen p95 contracts.

All twelve scenario observations require their exact domains, tags and tick count, dt=1/60, one substep, one spatial publication, normal public trace, the same simulation instance, no private state, complete named measurements and the frozen submission/advance/readback work budgets.
The exact plain and validation backend observations and all frozen negative controls are required. Legacy variable-timestep evidence cannot be relabeled or unioned into the report.

Portable deterministic tests cover a complete passing capture plus missing scenarios, wrong timestep/substep, hidden retry or changed work budget, missing measurement, failed simulation, identity mismatch, private state, negative-control failure, missing capability, unsupported public case and short or slow workloads. The validator is reusable by CPU, CUDA, Vulkan, D3D12 and Metal qualification tasks.

history.reason: Initial implementation proved the frozen suite lacks executable scenario fixtures and exposed a 49-vs-45 Metal capability mismatch; tested gate retained on work/F8-58/Thomass-MacBook-Air for bounded replanning
